product_fidelity: IMAGE 1 is the PRODUCT — reproduce this exact shoe with total fidelity: the chunky low-top runner with bone/cream and warm grey panels, charcoal mesh, black lace cage with black-and-white speckled laces, the bold black 'AI' logo on the side panel, small orange accent stripes, a chunky white midsole and a gum-brown outsole. Do not redesign, recolor, or restyle the shoe. Keep the 'AI' logo crisp, correctly shaped and correctly placed. Do not add any other brand marks, wordmarks or small text onto the shoe itself.
